<div class="card-body">
'''Rodian''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ローディアン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">同じ位置カード上の自分のバウンティ・ハンターと密輸屋はそれぞれ戦闘力＋1。ただし「グリード」は逆に戦闘力－1となる。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋1。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Rodian-PSA-93071763.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">スークーは典型的なローディアン男性だ。チャッザ族の長、赤のナヴィックの命令でグリードを殺しに来た。ローディアンは“狩り”を好み、多くが暗殺者として雇われている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rodian.

'''Card text:'''
Your bounty hunters and smugglers at the same location card are each power +1. Greedo is instead power -1. Adds 1 to the power of any starship he pilots.

'''Lore:'''
Suku is a typical male Rodian. On orders from Navik the Red, head of the Chattza tribe, he came to kill Greedo. Rodians like the hunt, and many are hired as assassins.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese names Suku (スークー) where English names Thuku, and Greedo as 「グリード」.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rodian]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
